desktop.notes:
• Crop, as in Cullect: dragging just outside the frame turns the frame over a still photo (hold E to turn the photo instead). The label rides on the frame's top edge, and a free frame close to a standard shape shows ≈ 3:2 there - click it for exactly that shape (green ✓ 3:2 when it already is). Pushing the frame into the photo's edge slides it along instead of stopping it, and a frame on the edge no longer jumps on the next drag.
• Crop bar on the photo: its shapes and Landscape / Portrait work now; Enter = done, Esc = cancel (back to how the frame was when you opened it).
• C in the Library: opens Edit straight into the crop frame.
• Letters never jump to another photo any more (E in Edit used to); the Keys list shows every crop key.
